sloka: तपः तस्याम् हि कुर्वत्याम् परिचर्याम् चकार ह ।सहस्राक्षो नरश्रेष्ठ परया गुण संपदा ॥१-४६-९॥
transliteration: tapaḥ tasyām hi kurvatyām paricaryām cakāra ha ।sahasrākṣo naraśreṣṭha parayā guṇa saṁpadā ॥1-46-9॥

translations.english: O foremost of men great treasure of virtues while she was practising austerities, the thousandeyed Indra began to serve her.
